title: The Jewish War — Flavius Josephus
creator: Flavius Josephus
date: ca. 75 CE work; Perseus English translation 1895
provenance: Perseus Digital Library edition. Josephus's preface self-identifies the author and states that he first fought against the Romans and was later compelled to be present at subsequent events.
notes: Primary source for Josephus's authorship/self-positioning and for his detailed account of the war.
Proximity does not remove authorial perspective or source-critical limitations.
